caelestia.role: Initial upstream source baseline; local port commits follow this commit.

quickshell.role: Windows backend and QML compatibility interfaces. Preserves nunreasonable/quickshell e8ae0ef124b1c14b547c80d00422d2ffbd423d81, native mask hover handoff, Core Audio capability/error reporting, UPower observation validity, GSMTC initialization/session-scan status, profile-isolated artwork caching, verified power profile results, confirm-only Bluetooth pairing, opt-in strict brightness routes with owned gamma restoration, explicit-consent notification mirroring, M3 tiling/Hypr window observation with allowlist scope and fitting outcomes, the single-desktop placeholder fix, 64-bit brightness query request ids, DPI-unaware tiling placement, and native virtual-desktop workspace dispatch, and global hotkeys with profile-local overrides and live reload. Typed app/screen tiling selectors and leak/crash lifetime fixes. Explorer reconnection for workspace dispatch and MTA-worker audio sessions. Foreground-thread keyboard layout and Caps Lock/Num Lock observation. Single-window outer gaps and focus/scheme DWM border colours with lifecycle restoration. Browser fullscreen suspends tiling before floating style rules; failed automatic tiling is retried on a larger physical monitor; explicit exclusions still apply during fullscreen. Opt-in QPC transition trace (QS_TRANSITION_TRACE) and a monotonic tiler clock. Fullscreen keeps its layout slot through a smaller display mode, work-area and DPI changes, rapid re-entry and a minimize on exit, with neighbours keeping their exact tiles; detection tolerates a small inset and bridges a display-mode change; reserve bars seed the panel z-order when they register below an already fullscreen application; a minimize is not treated as a fullscreen exit; a regained frame style confirms an exit whose rectangle still looks fullscreen, and the display-mode latch is bound to the exact fullscreen frame and monitor. Windows shell surfaces are classified once (CoreWindow only under explorer or a shell host); they never become tracked toplevels, foreground applications or AppBar fullscreen seeds. Cloaking is classified by DWMWA_CLOAKED flags: a shell cloak keeps the mapped tile, while an app or inherited cloak publishes hidden, releases the tiled space like a minimize, and preserves the fullscreen episode and latch for an uncloak restore. The Alt+Tab Task Switching overlay classes, including MultitaskingViewFrame and TaskSwitcherOverlayWnd, are rejected before they can become toplevels, so the primary-display-only QML fullscreen path cannot fire. Every deferred AppBar opening carries a generation; each episode retries at 150/500 ms, a stale retry does nothing, and a close bumps the generation. Seelen UI windows (seelen-ui.exe), including its Alt+Tab Task Switcher, are shell surfaces. Optional CPU temperature from LibreHardwareMonitor's local web server. Hyprland dispatcher mappings for relative workspace moves, pin actions, exact and percentage resize, a splitratio alias, and named refusals for special workspaces and window groups. Super chords stay on the keyboard hook unless a bind sets register to true; those use RegisterHotKey and keep a hook masking tap so the Start menu still stays closed when the Windows key is released, except chords the desktop supervisor consumes; a swallowed Super chord also masks and replays the Win key release, so Explorer's Win+V flyout cannot open next to the shell's picker. FloatingWindow.frameless removes a Windows toplevel's title bar and frame while keeping resize borders, snap, minimize, shadow and rounded corners. A tiled window that resizes itself, such as a remote desktop session growing into fullscreen, gets a quiet interval to settle before the tiler corrects or floats it, and eases back into its tile instead of snapping. Backend dev.

m3shapes.role: Material 3 Expressive shape QML plugin. Upstream Caelestia split it into this external project (caelestia-dots/shell 24aa15ee) and pins the same revision in flake.nix/flake.lock. The Windows portable plugin build compiles and installs the M3Shapes QML module.

schemeCli.role: Dynamic Material You scheme generation. Installed into a virtual environment under the isolated combined profile, never into the repository; only its scheme/material modules are used, not the Linux theme writer.

iiWindowsReference.role: Porting and packaging reference. Its sources.lock supplies the backend pin; it is not the Caelestia UI dependency.
